summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting, Proxy Statement, and Proxy Form for the AGM scheduled for September 16, 2026. The agenda includes re-election of Class II directors, ratification of Deloitte Touche S.A. as auditor, and other routine matters. The record date is July 20, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic actions. No deal terms or unusual events are present.
